minutes.headline: Board heard a municipal building estimate of 21 to 22.3 million; cannabis agreement and climate policy deferred.
minutes.summary: Board welcomed the new town manager on her first day, approved a toll booth, a videographer and a Conservation Commission appointment. A joint meeting with the municipal building design committee heard the Taylor and Burns design and cost estimate. The board reviewed Budget Task Force recommendations without final decisions, and public comment was mostly on the building project.

what_happened.line: In a joint meeting with the municipal building design committee, the Select Board heard the design and a cost estimate for the project, with no vote taken.
The board deferred the Bliss cannabis host community agreement to the 18th and asked for a redline of the workplace climate survey policy.
The board reviewed Budget Task Force recommendations and made no final decisions until the absent member is present.
The town manager is to consider two capital planning articles, one with and one without municipal building work.
The board voted unanimously for a Teens Center toll booth, a Conservation Commission appointment and a videographer for public access cable.

why_it_matters: The municipal building estimate is the figure residents are likely to be asked to fund, and the two capital articles under consideration would let voters weigh the project separately from other capital needs.
The Budget Task Force recommendations and the cannabis host agreement's impact-fee terms both bear on future tax bills and town revenue, and neither is settled.
watch_next: Return of the Bliss cannabis host community agreement to the board on the 18th.
The town manager's capital planning articles, one with and one without municipal building work, and any board decision on the Budget Task Force recommendations.
